title: Kōnan Railway Kōnan Line
summary: This document is about the Kōnan Railway Kōnan Line, a railway route operated by the Japanese private railway company Kōnan Railway in Aomori Prefecture, running from Hirosaki Station to Kuroishi Station. The document covers several main topics: a station list (noting that Tamboāto Station operates seasonally from April to November); rolling stock information, detailing the use of former Tokyu 6000 and 7000 series EMUs, the previous use and 2008 withdrawal of ex-Nankai Railway 1521 series EMUs, and an electric locomotive used for winter snow-clearing duties; the history of the line, including the company's founding in 1926, the start of operations in 1927, electrification milestones, voltage increases, line extensions, and the end of freight services in 1984; a former connecting line from Kuroishi to Kawabe on the Ou Main Line, opened in 1912 and closed in 1998; and an accident record, specifically a 2007 train derailment at Hiraka Station that caused no injuries. The document also includes references and external links to the Konan Railway website.
